# Component templates

Annotated skeletons for the component types in [PLUGIN_SPEC.md](../PLUGIN_SPEC.md). They show **structure and voice only**, using a neutral
topic (immutable value objects) that belongs to no book in this repository. Do not copy their wording or their example; write original content for your book.

| File | Shows |
| --- | --- |
| [skill-hub.md](skill-hub.md) | The `principles` hub skill |
| [skill-topical.md](skill-topical.md) | A model-invocable topical skill |
| [skill-workflow.md](skill-workflow.md) | A manual workflow skill, and the `context: fork` variant |
| [agent-reviewer.md](agent-reviewer.md) | A read-only specialist reviewer |
| [agent-implementer.md](agent-implementer.md) | An implementer that edits files |
| [agent-lead-and-gate.md](agent-lead-and-gate.md) | The `lead` router and the `final-gate` checker |
| [output-style.md](output-style.md) | An output style (mode) |
| [plugin-readme-outline.md](plugin-readme-outline.md) | README section order |
